Subject: Demo — proposed Tue Jun 30 / budget timing

Hi Olivia,

Great speaking with you yesterday — thanks for the context on your evaluation timeline. Per our call we'd love to walk the Athena team through a 45-minute product demo + 15-minute Q&A.

Would Tue, Jun 30 at 10:00 AM PT work for your engineering and procurement leads? If that doesn't fit, happy to propose two shorter sessions (platform + security) or move to the week of Jul 6 to better align with your budget planning.

Attached is a short agenda and a one-page SOW stub so procurement can preview the terms.

Agenda attachment: Redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
SOW attachment: SOW-stub.docx (DOCX, 24KB)

Best,
Marissa

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@athena-fin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo — proposed Tue Jun 30 / budget timing

Hi Marissa — thanks for the follow-up and for sending the materials.

Quick update: Finance just announced a temporary spend freeze while they finalize FY allocations — looks like any pilot approvals are paused until the mid-July budgeting window closes. Given that, could we move the full demo to week of Jul 13–17? Alternatively, we could do a short technical intro (20–30 mins) the week of Jun 29 just for the engineering folks so they can start scoping integration work — but procurement won't engage until after the freeze.

If you have a suggested near-term option, happy to discuss.

Regards,
Olivia Chen
Director of Engineering, Athena Finance
olivia.chen@athena-fin.com | +1 212-555-2233

Laura / Aditya — forwarding Olivia's note. Finance freeze means procurement won't engage until mid-July. Two options I see:

1) Offer a short technical kickoff (30 mins) the week of Jun 29 for engineers only — keeps momentum and lets them scope integration work.
2) Move the full demo to the week of Jul 13–17 and use the extra time to get procurement a tailored SOW and pricing options.

Thoughts on (a) offering a short engineering-only slot (we can send a lightweight agenda) and (b) whether we should pre-author a small pilot discount to help move them post-freeze?

—Marissa

Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Sounds fine — propose we offer Jul 8 as a compromise (earlier than mid-Jul but after internal approvals for some teams). I can sign off on a small time-limited pilot discount (2 weeks, 20% off) if you want to present that as a one-off to procurement.
>
> —Laura

Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai> wrote:

>
> —Aditya

1) Engineering intro — 30 minutes, technical team only (no procurement) the week of Jun 29–Jul 2 (if any slots remain).
2) Full demo + procurement kickoff — Thu, Jul 8 at 12:00 PM PT (45 min demo + 15 min Q&A).

If Jul 8 works, we'll send a calendar invite and include the agenda and SOW preview for procurement to review once their freeze lifts. If you'd prefer the short engineering intro first, let me know preferred day/time and we'll make it happen.
